china_race_dynamics.text: The Chinese Communist Party (CCP) intends to surpass us as the frontrunner in scientific knowledge and technological development, and they’re committing extensive resources to crucial technologies like artificial intelligence, quantum information sciences, critical mineral development and advanced manufacturing. Falling behind will threaten our national security, our global competitiveness, and jobs here at home.

deepseek.reason: The speaker frames China's AI advances as a race whose loss threatens US security and competitiveness.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The race framing and falling-behind threat are explicit, though no specific policy is named.
